rows.text: The Assembly's Speaker page states that 'Hon. Veikune was appointed the Speaker of the Legislative Assembly by His Majesty King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV on the 22nd of March 2005, to replace Hon. Tu'ivakano who has appointed as the new Minister of Works', that the Speaker is appointed from one of the 9 Noble Representatives, and that Hon. Veikune, the Noble's No. 1 Representative from Vava'u, was re-elected in March 2005.
rows.locator: Body paragraph 1 after the heading 'The Speaker of the House'; body paragraph 2, first two sentences
rows.uncertainty: An Assembly web page, not the royal instrument. It dates the appointment, not an effective day, so it gives attested_on, not from. It gives no day on which Tu'ivakano's tenure ended. The same wording appears in the Assembly's 2005 brochure (a lead only).

rows.text: The same page says that Hon. Veikune 'is not new to the position of Speaker, as he was the Speaker from 1999 to 2002'.
rows.uncertainty: Retrospective year span; attested_on is the capture date, not an observation of the 1999-2002 office. It conflicts with the Assembly's 2006 list (1998-2001) and its 2011 lists (1999-2001). Not a boundary.
